C1145247.failed_steps: Failed at step 2: in the Customer menu list a long name with no spaces is squeezed into a one-line row - cut off at the top and drawn over the next customer and its tick box.
C1145247.source: From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 13 (Change Log: version 12 on 12 Nov 2026 by Milos Vasic, version 13 on 13 Nov 2026 by Chris Ward), read 13 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location) S5-R13 (version 13): “The customer chip (A/R) and vendor chip (A/P) and their open menus are the native ones: Customer exactly as Sales By Customer's Customer filter (person icon), Vendor exactly as Inventory Value's Vendor filter (truck icon, "Search vendors"; as there, the search box shows only when there are more than 8 vendors). The menu has a search box, an "All customers" or "All vendors" row, the native line "All customers are included. Pick one or more to narrow." (or vendors) while none is ticked, and the list; several can be ticked. The chip reads "Customer: All customers" or "Vendor: All vendors" in the resting (grey) style when none is ticked, the name when one is (shortened with "..." when long), and "Customer: N customers" or "Vendor: N vendors" when N are. The ticked customers or vendors narrow every row, group, total, page, sort and export; the Location list does not change (S5-R3).” From: Slack, Chris Ward (product owner), 13 Nov 2026, thread in channel C0C454MLP0T, read 13 Nov 2026 Slack, Chris Ward, Picture #1: “Picture #1 — the long customer name wrap issue (shows up in the filter)”
C1145247.ticket: Follow the status here https://shopview.atlassian.net/browse/SV-12722 (Ready to Fix, read 14 Nov 2026) - the known problem this test names.
C1145247.todo: What needs to be done: nothing for the tester now; re-run this test on staging when SV-12722 reaches Ready for QA.

C1145253.failed_steps: Failed at steps 1 and 2: customer A's name stays on one line across the group row; in step 1 the table is wider than the page and Past Due and Amount are hidden.
C1145253.source: From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 13 (Change Log: version 12 on 12 Nov 2026 by Milos Vasic, version 13 on 13 Nov 2026 by Chris Ward), read 13 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11538 (Story 8, Report descriptions and layout) S8-R3 (version 13): “The headline column (Open Balance; Total on the Summaries) is pinned to the right edge and bold on the header, every row, every expanded row and the Totals row, as on Sales By Customer. At 1440 pixels wide every column of all six reports is visible without scrolling sideways: the customer or vendor name and Transaction Type wrap long values onto a second line, Location wraps only on A/P Detail (nine columns) and A/P Unpaid Invoices, column headings never wrap, and money, date and number columns never wrap. Narrower than 1440 pixels, the table scrolls sideways under the pinned column. One exception, as today: on A/P Unpaid Invoices a vendor's group row does not wrap, so a very long vendor name (78 characters still fit) can make the table scroll sideways at 1440 pixels.”
C1145253.ticket: Follow the status here https://shopview.atlassian.net/browse/SV-12764 (Open, read 14 Nov 2026) - the known problem this test names.
C1145253.todo: What needs to be done: nothing for the tester now; re-run this test on staging when SV-12764 reaches Ready for QA.
